risk_notes: HIGHEST RISK -- '## Activation Path' heading: appears only in FEATURE templates. Renaming or translating it silently breaks consistency-check N-18 (check_feature_activation_path). ACTIVATION_PATH_HEADER_RE is anchored to that exact string.

HIGHEST RISK -- '## MVP Features' / '## Features': only headings detected by _DETAIL_FEATURES_HEADER_RE inside Epic detail files. Translating to German (e.g. '## MVP-Funktionen') silently disables E-15 detail-vs-backlog status drift check.

HIGHEST RISK -- ADR_CORE_HEADERS tuple (## Kontext, ## Context, ## Entscheidung, ## Decision, ## Konsequenzen, ## Consequences, ## Begruendung, ## Begründung, ## Considered Options): adding a new translation or renaming any of them turns the ADR abstraction check (A-1) silently off for that section.

HIGHEST RISK -- '### EPIC-NN: Title' heading: hard-anchored '^###\s+(EPIC-NN)' in three tools (consistency-check, flow.py, build_backlog). Changing the heading level or the colon prefix breaks epic discovery and title lookup.

HIGHEST RISK -- BACKLOG table column order (ID|Type|Title|Status|Phase|Prio|Refs|Source|Commit|Claim|Last change|Notes): four tools rely on index positions (status=3, phase=4, claim=10 in flow.py; STATUS_COLUMN_INDEX=4 in migrate_status_vocabulary using split('|') with leading empty cell). Inserting/removing/reordering any column silently corrupts every parse.
HIGH RISK -- '<!-- DIA:sub-issues -->' / '<!-- /DIA:sub-issues -->' markers: only used in GitHub epic bodies; touching either string strands the tasklist render. Pair is matched literally.

HIGH RISK -- DIA-WORKFLOW-START/END markers (MD and HASH variants): renaming, dropping the parenthetical, or changing spacing breaks anchor.py replace/remove/verify across CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md/.cursorrules/.windsurfrules/copilot.
HIGH RISK -- FIXME(stub) marker: exact 'FIXME(stub):' string with optional 'see FIX-EE-FF-NN' suffix drives E-14 bidirectional binding. Whitespace tolerant but the keyword string is fixed.

HIGH RISK -- '> Source of truth:' and 'Issue: <url>' lines in GitHub issue body / backlog Notes column: rewriting them breaks write_issue_into_backlog (idempotence test) and preflight issue-state sample which greps Notes for 'https://github.com/.../issues/N'.

MEDIUM RISK -- Status vocabulary strings (Backlog/Ready/In Progress/In Review/Done plus legacy Planned/Active/Review/Waiting/Deferred): casefold-matched in flow.py against GitHub project options. Adding new states or renaming requires updating ALLOWED_STATUSES, LEGACY_STATUS_MAPPING, _STATUS_DONE/_STATUS_OPEN, STATUS_MAP in migrate_status_vocabulary, and the project field on GitHub.

MEDIUM RISK -- 'Wiring offen' / 'stub' / 'deferred-stub' substring scan in BACKLOG row notes (E-14 fix-without-stub-evidence). 'stub' is short enough to false-positive on unrelated text; renaming/translating breaks the inverse check.

MEDIUM RISK -- Issue checklist line patterns ('- [ ] BA', '- [ ] RE', '- [ ] Architecture', '- [ ] Coding', '- [ ] Testing', '- [ ] Security-Audit', '- [ ] Ready for review'): tick_checklist relies on these exact labels in the issue body. Translating breaks phase ticks.

MEDIUM RISK -- '## Active Epics', '## Cross-cutting (ADRs, Plans, no Epic)', '## Dashboard': rendered verbatim by build_backlog but the BACKLOG-TEMPLATE the skill writes must mirror them so a hand-edited BACKLOG round-trips. Renaming the template heading without updating build_backlog drifts the next regenerate.

MEDIUM RISK -- ADR core-section translation matrix: removing one of the German variants (## Kontext, ## Entscheidung, ## Konsequenzen, ## Begruendung/Begründung) silently disables the abstraction check for German-only ADR templates.

MEDIUM RISK -- '## Sub-Issues' legacy heading: only a one-time migration path in flow.render_epic_body. If a new template introduces '## Sub-Issues' for unrelated content, render_epic_body will rewrite it.
LOW RISK -- 'BA-{PROJECT}.md' literal filename check in consistency-check N-8. Project-BA must keep this exact placeholder shape, otherwise it gets misclassified as a generic legacy BA.

LOW RISK -- ID schema regexes are duplicated across tools (ITEM_RE in flow.py, FIX_ID_RE, ID_PATTERNS in consistency-check, EPIC_RE/FEAT_RE/IMP_RE/FIX_RE in renumber, ITEM_ID_RE in migrate_status_vocabulary). Any change to id format (e.g. allowing 3-digit suffixes) must update every copy.
LOW RISK -- HANDOFFS.md and BACKLOG.md.preMigration filenames are skipped by renumber/migration tooling by literal path. Renaming HANDOFFS.md loses the append-only protection.
